note: TVA campground on Douglas Lake just above Douglas Dam, run under concession by Go Camp Tennessee (Vista Recreation). Two sections are split by a public boat ramp: most waterfront sites sit around a loop on a low grassy point beside the ramp, and the rest climb a hill near the swimming beach and picnic area. The lake is drawn down heavily outside summer, leaving a wide bare shore below the sites. --Claude
summary: TVA/Go Camp Tennessee concession confirmed: 60 sites, $25-35 + $10 surcharge (Campspot 2026-10-13), 2-night minimum, 21-night max, some FCFS. Lakefront re-checked hard and kept: Campspot Waterfront RV sites 45-59 ring a grassy point ~18-20 m from the vegetation/high-water line, pads ~4 m above the drawn-down shore. Google 4.6 (1,021).
